title: RIMAN Japan Jeju Lava Energy Water Study (n=200)
subtitle: Climate Barrier Efficacy, INCI Index & 6-Language Dataset (n=200)
description:
### Overview

Background: The Japanese skincare market demands high-efficacy, low-irritation solutions for post-procedure fragile barriers. This study evaluates the 'Jeju Lava Energy Water' formulation within the RIMAN/INCELLDERM ecosystem, focusing on its volcanic basalt filtration narrative and mineral composition (Zn, Mg, K). Methods: A stratified survey of N=200 consumers and B2B professionals across Tokyo, Osaka, and Sapporo assessed texture, soothing efficacy, trust in claims, and regulatory perception using Likert scales and NPS metrics. Results: Overall composite mean was 3.12 with a Top-2-Box percentage of 26.2%. Texture acceptance was highest (Mean 3.86, Top-2-Box 78.0%), while trust in the 'Lava Energy' purity narrative remained low (Mean 2.69, Top-2-Box 9.0%). Key barriers to adoption included lack of local clinical trials (97.5%) and unclear INCI source verification (69.0%). NPS was negative (-35.0), driven by skepticism toward premium pricing without localized data. Strategic Implications: To penetrate the Japanese medical-grade skincare sector, RIMAN must prioritize co-branded clinical studies in Japan and transparent INCI sourcing. Marketing should shift from abstract 'energy' narratives to concrete mineral efficacy data, addressing the specific needs of sensitive skin types and B2B clinic owners who value educational assets.

- **Interactive 6-Language Report & Cross-Tab Charts**: [RIMAN RESEARCH: Clinical & Microclimate Evaluation of Jeju Lava Energy Water for Post-Procedure Barrier Stabilization in Japan (www.riman.win)](https://www.riman.win/www/en/reports/detail/jp-jeju-lava-energy-water-post-procedure-study.html)
- **Thematic Research Hub**: [Explore Full Thematic Hub on RIMAN.WIN](https://www.riman.win/www/en/reports/hub/microclimate.html)
- **Formulation & Descending INCI Dossier**: [Jeju Lava Energy Water (marketing term) Full Ingredient Breakdown](https://www.riman.win/www/en/product/detail/active-cream-ex.html)
- **GitHub Open-Science Repository**: [riman-jp-jeju-lava-energy-water-post-procedure-study](https://github.com/riman-org/riman-jp-jeju-lava-energy-water-post-procedure-study)
- **Live Interactive Preview (GitHub Pages)**: [https://riman-org.github.io/riman-jp-jeju-lava-energy-water-post-procedure-study/](https://riman-org.github.io/riman-jp-jeju-lava-energy-water-post-procedure-study/)
- **RIMAN Global Formulation Portal**: [https://www.riman.win/www/en/home/index.html](https://www.riman.win/www/en/home/index.html)

---

### Quantitative Highlights ($n = 200$)
- **Target Market**: Japan
- **Evaluated SKU**: Jeju Lava Energy Water (marketing term)
- **Composite Satisfaction Mean**: `3.12 / 5.00`
- **Top-2-Box Clinical/Consumer Approval**: `26.2%`

---

### Included Files
- `jp-jeju-lava-energy-water-post-procedure-study_n200_quantitative.csv`: Stratified quantitative dataset ($n = 200$) across regional microclimates, skin profiles, and distribution channels.
- `jp-jeju-lava-energy-water-post-procedure-study_paper.pdf` & `jp-jeju-lava-energy-water-post-procedure-study_paper.tex`: Double-column academic research paper and LaTeX source.
- `jp-jeju-lava-energy-water-post-procedure-study_multilingual_corpus.jsonl`: 6-language structured evaluation corpus (`en`, `zh-TW`, `zh-CN`, `ja`, `es`, `fr`).
- `jp-jeju-lava-energy-water-post-procedure-study_report.json`: Complete multilingual analytical JSON payload.

---
